query: What is recommended for optimizing fuel efficiency when using air-conditioning in a vehicle?
reference_answer: Avoid setting the air-conditioning temperature too low and increase the fan speed instead.
context:
[Document 1]
Driving the vehicle in the right gear will increase fuel efficiency and reduce emissions.

[Document 2]
Avoid setting the air-conditioning temperature too low and increase the fan speed instead.

[Document 3]

answer: According to Document 2, to optimize fuel efficiency while using air conditioning, avoid setting the temperature too low and increase fan speed instead. [Document 2]
